description: Save an edited design.md (full document from get_design_md). Only values you changed are written: a frontmatter value left as returned is not written and keeps its current behavior, a changed radius or heading font is pinned, and a changed layout token is written into the design direction ahead of its prose. Removing a key or section leaves it unchanged; an empty Voice or Design direction section clears it (an empty direction returns to brand-derived defaults). The Reference email section is read-only. Invalid values fail with line-numbered issues; unknown keys are ignored with warnings. Pass dryRun: true to preview changes and warnings without saving. Pass expectedVersion from get_design_md; on a 409 conflict, read again and reapply your edits.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

dryRun.description: true validates and reports changes and warnings without saving.

expectedVersion.description: version from get_design_md. Recommended: the save fails with a conflict if design.md changed since that read.

markdown.description: The full design.md document: optional --- YAML frontmatter --- followed by Markdown with ## Voice and ## Design direction sections. Other ## sections are kept as part of the design direction.

name: update_design_md

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `update_design_md` MCP tool.

changes.description: Changed fields in document terms, e.g. colors.primary, voice, designDirection, layout.spine.

designSystem.description: The design system in effect after the save.

dryRun.description: True when nothing was saved by request.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

markdown.description: The document as it reads after the save (or would read, for a dry run).

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

saved.description: True when this call wrote changes.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

version.description: Current version after the call; unchanged for a dry run or an untouched document.

warnings.description: Non-blocking notes ({message, line?}): ignored keys, read-only sections, values a saved AI style overrides.
